sources.title: Biosequestration of copper by bacteria isolated from an abandoned mine by using microbially induced calcite precipitation
sources.publication: Journal of General and Applied Microbiology 62(4):206–212 (2016)
sources.version: Final journal PDF; 7 pages; publisher release 2016-09-12, advance publication 2016-08-04
sources.role: Existing primary experiment, same published bytes as round85
sources.inspection: Complete original text reread; printed pp. 207,208,210,211 rendered and visually inspected, particularly Fig.1 and Figs.6–8; linked publisher metadata inspected.
sources.claims: Minor source-assigned azurite feature in a mixed trace; BPU caption distinct from YA solution assay; original strain/recipe inconsistencies retained.
limits: No specimen-specific raw diffraction, fitted phase quantities or azurite-specific control pattern acquired.
Generic culture/precipitate preparation does not fully specify the copper-bearing Fig.7 sample.
5 microlitres, 2 mM and 48 h in Methods versus 2 M and 72 h in Results; Fig.8 begins near 270 mg/L.
61.8% solution concentration decrease is not an azurite recovery yield.
sources.decision: Keep qualified owner; not new experiment or correction
sources.license: Publisher copyright shown; article-specific redistribution permission not established; full text/figures stay outside Git

sources.version: Advance publication dated 2016-08-04; 7 pages; distinct PDF bytes from final
sources.inspection: Targeted Methods/Results and Figs.7–8 compared; PDF pages 3,5,6 visually inspected; extracted full text retained.
sources.decision: Same target contradictions and plots persist; not an independent experiment or resolving correction. Advance landing search result directs readers to final journal version.

locators.culture_claim: Claim1; paragraphs[0018],[0045] and[0079] name B-22 and KCTC13061BP, deposited2016-07-13
locators.sequence_link: Paragraph[0042] explicitly calls KJ485701 B-22; original front page lists KJ485701.1 among prior-art documents
locators.sample_preparation: Paragraph[0069] adds suspension of prepared carbonate samples in100 microlitres distilled water before glass deposition and50°C drying
locators.phase: Paragraphs[0071]–[0073],Fig.7 (p.13): same named mixed phases, no raw data/quantitative refinement

sources.decision: Retain as source-attributed deposit/preparation lead. Do not assert B-22=B7-22 or independent replication; target Figures7–8 visually repeat journal trace/time course.
limits: No B7-22 alias explanation or actual sequence listing/culture certificate in the inspected13-page publication.
No certified link from deposited culture to exact journal diffraction specimen or original instrument data.
Patent does not call itself a journal correction and repeats target contradictions.
Patent scope/industrial-use language is not deployment evidence; no legal-status or legal-validity conclusion made.
sources.license: Public original patent document mirrored by Google Patents; article-specific reuse rights not assessed; no PDF, image or source full text committed
